signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.description: Start with a free organization. You can invite your team afterwards.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.description: We sent a confirmation link to {email}.
checkEmail.demoHint: This is the public demo, so emails aren't sent. Open the demo inbox to read it.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Your other sessions will be signed out.
reset.failed: The link is invalid or has expired.

inbox.title: Demo inbox
inbox.description: Emails sent to the addresses you used in this browser. In the demo nothing leaves the server.

onboarding.title: Welcome, {name}
onboarding.description: Set up your organization. You'll be its owner.
onboarding.slugHint: Your customer portal will live at /portal/{slug}.

invite.title: Join {org}
invite.description: You're invited as {role}. The invitation is for {email}.
invite.invalid: This invitation has expired, was revoked, or was already used.
invite.wrongAccount: You're signed in with a different email. Sign in as {email} to accept.
